question: Take the genes with region-enriched RNA expression in cerebellum and those region-enriched in cerebral cortex. Give the size of each set. Compute the Spearman correlation of nTPM across all brain regions between the two sets' mean profiles. Draw a heatmap of the twenty cerebellum-enriched genes with the highest cerebellum nTPM across all brain regions. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA brain regional specificity\" AS specificity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, \"RNA brain regional specificity\", \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched' AND \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE '%cerebell%' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH sets AS (SELECT Gene, CASE WHEN \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE 'cerebellum:%' THEN 'cerebellum' WHEN \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE 'cerebral cortex:%' THEN 'cerebral cortex' END AS set_name FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched' AND (\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE 'cerebellum:%' OR \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE 'cerebral cortex:%')), profiles AS (SELECT s.set_name, b.\"Brain region\" AS region, AVG(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) AS mean_ntpm FROM sets s JOIN rna_brain_region_hpa b ON s.Gene=b.Gene GROUP BY 1,2), wide AS (SELECT region, MAX(mean_ntpm) FILTER (WHERE set_name='cerebellum') AS cerebellum_mean, MAX(mean_ntpm) FILTER (WHERE set_name='cerebral cortex') AS cortex_mean FROM profiles GROUP BY 1), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cerebellum_mean) AS rc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cortex_mean) AS rx FROM wide) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE set_name='cerebellum') AS cerebellum_set_size, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE set_name='cerebral cortex') AS cerebral_cortex_set_size, CORR(rc, rx) AS spearman_rho, COUNT(*) AS brain_regions FROM ranked"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH top AS (SELECT Gene, Gene_name, cerebellum_ntpm FROM (SELECT p.Gene, p.\"Gene synonym\" AS Gene_name, TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", 'cerebellum: ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS cerebellum_ntpm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", 'cerebellum: ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) DESC, p.Gene) AS rn FROM proteinatlas p WHERE p.\"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched' AND p.\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" LIKE 'cerebellum:%') WHERE rn<=20) SELECT t.Gene, t.cerebellum_ntpm, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='amygdala') AS amygdala, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='basal ganglia') AS basal_ganglia, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='cerebellum') AS cerebellum, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='cerebral cortex') AS cerebral_cortex, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='choroid plexus') AS choroid_plexus, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='hippocampal formation') AS hippocampal_formation, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='hypothalamus') AS hypothalamus, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='medulla oblongata') AS medulla_oblongata, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='midbrain') AS midbrain, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='pons') AS pons, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='spinal cord') AS spinal_cord, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='thalamus') AS thalamus, MAX(TRY_CAST(b.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE b.\"Brain region\"='white matter') AS white_matter FROM top t JOIN rna_brain_region_hpa b ON b.Gene=t.Gene GROUP BY t.Gene,t.cerebellum_ntpm ORDER BY t.cerebellum_ntpm DESC,t.Gene"}
